members.name: acos
members.doc: Return the arc cosine of z.

members.name: acosh
members.doc: Return the inverse hyperbolic cosine of z.

members.name: asin
members.doc: Return the arc sine of z.

members.name: asinh
members.doc: Return the inverse hyperbolic sine of z.

members.name: atan
members.doc: Return the arc tangent of z.

members.name: atanh
members.doc: Return the inverse hyperbolic tangent of z.

members.name: cos
members.doc: Return the cosine of z.

members.name: cosh
members.doc: Return the hyperbolic cosine of z.

members.name: exp
members.doc: Return the exponential value e**z.

members.name: isclose
members.doc: Determine whether two complex numbers are close in value. rel_tol maximum difference for being considered "close", relative to the magnitude of the input values

members.name: isfinite
members.doc: Return True if both the real and imaginary parts of z are finite, else False.

members.name: isinf
members.doc: Checks if the real or imaginary part of z is infinite.

members.name: isnan
members.doc: Checks if the real or imaginary part of z not a number (NaN).

members.name: log
members.doc: log(z[, base]) -> the logarithm of z to the given base. If the base is not specified, returns the natural logarithm (base e) of z.

members.name: log10
members.doc: Return the base-10 logarithm of z.

members.name: phase
members.doc: Return argument, also known as the phase angle, of a complex.

members.name: polar
members.doc: Convert a complex from rectangular coordinates to polar coordinates. r is the distance from 0 and phi the phase angle.

members.name: rect
members.doc: Convert from polar coordinates to rectangular coordinates.

members.name: sin
members.doc: Return the sine of z.

members.name: sinh
members.doc: Return the hyperbolic sine of z.

members.name: sqrt
members.doc: Return the square root of z.

members.name: tan
members.doc: Return the tangent of z.

members.name: tanh
members.doc: Return the hyperbolic tangent of z.
